subject: general
question: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana was launched on:
solution:
The correct answer is __**1 May 2016.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) was launched on **May 1, 2016, by Prime Minister Narendra Modi.**
 
• Beneficiaries are mainly **women from BPL households**, with a special focus on SC/ST communities.
 
• The applicant must be a woman, **over 18 years of age**, from a BPL household, and without an existing LPG connection.
 
• Families identified under **Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) 2011 data**.
